note: Fix round on feature/mudanca-negocio-slide-deck, previous HEAD 4d61161. Scope: QA-BLOCK-1 (High) — decodeURIComponent(match[1]) in parseSlideParam() threw an uncaught URIError on malformed ?slide= values (e.g. '?slide=%'), which escaped to the bootstrap-level try/catch in the deck.js IIFE and collapsed the whole deck into the continuous-scroll no-JS fallback (all 5 sections visible, no counter, URL never normalized) instead of the AC1-required silent fallback to slide 1 with the URL normalized to ?slide=1. Fix: dropped the decodeURIComponent call entirely — a valid ?slide= value only ever needs to match /^[0-9]+$/, so the raw (still percent-encoded) capture is validated directly against that regex; any malformed/percent-escaped/non-numeric value now simply fails the regex and falls back to slide 1, and no decode step exists that can throw. Also, while in scope: fixed dev/watchdog-flagged stale comments in deck.js, deck-nav.js, and css/deck.css that referred to a non-existent 'SLIDES' array — named the actual slide-order array literal (previously inline at the Hotsite.deck.init(...) call site) as an explicit SLIDE_IDS constant and updated all three cross-file comments to point at it. Did not touch scripts/verify-mudanca-negocio-slide-deck.cjs or agentic.config.yaml (qa-engineer's concurrent scope on this same branch).

runs.caveat: Owned by qa-engineer and possibly mid-edit concurrently on this branch; run here only to confirm no regression from this fix, not as this agent's authoritative gate verdict.

manual_repro.description: Opened presentations/mudanca-para-negocio/index.html?slide=% (the exact malformed value from QA-BLOCK-1) in a real headless Chromium instance via Playwright, before and after the fix.

before_fix.verdict: confirmed bug: collapsed to continuous-scroll fallback, URL never normalized, no functional counter

after_fix.verdict: AC1-compliant: silent fallback to slide 1, URL normalized via replaceState, zero errors
